events.verdict: Coulibaly's (WAS) left hand grazes Kuzma's (MIL) right arm as his right hand makes simultaneous contact with the ball.
After Coulibaly (WAS) dislodges the ball, Kuzma (MIL) dislodges Coulibaly and causes him to go out of bounds.
Coulibaly (WAS) establishes himself in Green's (MIL) path prior to the contact.
Sarr (WAS) releases away from Trent Jr. (MIL) following the expiration of the pick.
Turner (MIL) is retreating his arm into a vertical position as he defends Sarr's (WAS) shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) applies his hand to Kuzma's (MIL) side and immediately removes his hand as Kuzma enters his upward shooting motion.
George (WAS) extends his off-arm into Kuzma (MIL) and delivers contact that affects his ability to defend.
Trent Jr. (MIL) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, George's (WAS) jersey as they pursue the rebound.

Replay review of the foul called on Turner (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. The review confirmed contact between Turner and Carrington (WAS) during Carrington's shot attempt.
Carrington (WAS) legally contests Green's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Green (MIL) initiates contact with Middleton's (WAS) arm that affects his ability to pass the ball.
George (WAS) cleanly blocks Rollins' (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Green (MIL) moves laterally into Coulibaly's (WAS) path and initiates body contact that affects Coulibaly's SQBR.
